LanguageData.Phon_TF_TakeFlightDesc: Fly {MOUNT_labelShort} to a spot up to {RANGE} cells away, straight over walls, water and anything else in the way.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_TakeFlightCooldown: Afterwards {MOUNT_labelShort} needs {TIME} to rest before flying again.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_MountFatigued: {MOUNT_labelShort} is still resting from the last flight ({TIME} left).
LanguageData.Phon_TF_CarryingSomething: {RIDER_labelShort} can't take flight while carrying something.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_RoofedTakeOff: Needs open sky to take off.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_Overloaded: {MOUNT_labelShort} is carrying too much to fly ({LOAD} of {CAPACITY}).
LanguageData.Phon_TF_FlyWorldDesc: Fly {MOUNT_labelShort} and its rider to another tile on the world map. Every selected rider on a flying mount comes along, and the group flies as far as its shortest range.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_FlyCaravanDesc: Riders on flying mounts fly to another tile on the world map. Everyone else stays behind as a caravan. The group flies as far as its shortest range.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_NoWorldRange: {MOUNT_labelShort} can't fly across the world map.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_NoRiderForFlyer: Nobody in this caravan can ride its flying mounts.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_WouldStrand: The pawns left behind would have nobody to lead the caravan.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_OtherLayer: Flying mounts can't reach that layer.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_SettingIgnoreTerrainDesc: Riders on a flying mount move over marsh, mud, sand and water at no extra cost, and can cross deep water. Snow still slows them, and walls, buildings and closed doors still block them.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_SettingFlightDesc: Gives riders on a flying mount a button to fly to a spot within range.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_SettingOpenSkyDesc: Taking off and landing are only possible from and to unroofed cells.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_SettingTakeFlightSpeed: Take flight speed: {SPEED} cells per second
LanguageData.Phon_TF_SettingWorldFlightDesc: Gives riders on a flying mount, and caravans with them, a button to fly to another tile on the world map. Range depends on how much the mount carries compared to its carrying capacity.
LanguageData.Phon_TF_SettingMaxMultiplier: Max range multiplier for light loads: ×{MULT}
LanguageData.Phon_TF_SettingWorldSpeed: World flight speed: {SPEED} tiles per day
